title: Resolution computation and shift-model predicate for whole-system direct image
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, a supplied simultaneous operation package $o$, and an arbitrary scheme morphism $p:X\to Y$ [def-sf-integral-system-operations]. Write $S_p$ for its actual total derived direct image of strict systems, and $p_*^0$ for the ordinary sequence-site direct image. For unbounded complexes $M,I$ of strict-system modules and a quasi-isomorphism $a:M\to I$ [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules] into a K-injective complex [def-pur-kinjective-complex], define $c_a:S_p(QM)\xrightarrow{\sim}Q(p_*^0I)$ to be $S_p(Qa)$ followed by the inverse of the actual derived-unit component on $I$. Here $Q$ is localization to the ordinary unbounded derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Use the prescribed mate shift $\sigma_p$ of [def-pur-integral-operation-shift-data]. Define the predicate BasicSystemImageShiftModels to require, for every such $M,I,a$ and every $r\in\mathbf Z$, that $I[r]$ is K-injective, $a[r]$ is a quasi-isomorphism, and the following entire-system derived square commutes. The route $S_p(Q(M[r]))\to S_p((QM)[r])\to (S_p(QM))[r]\to (Q(p_*^0I))[r]$, using the localization shift, $\sigma_p$, and $c_a[r]$, equals the route $S_p(Q(M[r]))\xrightarrow{c_{a[r]}}Q(p_*^0(I[r]))\to Q((p_*^0I)[r])\to (Q(p_*^0I))[r]$, using the termwise direct-image shift and localization shift. This is a definition of a property of the fixed maps, not an existence or shift-compatibility assertion. No K-injectivity of individual evaluated or scalar-restricted systems is required.
